scenes.google_flow_prompt: High quality graphical breakdown card displaying Pros vs Cons for IntelliJ IDEA.
scenes.audio_narration: On the pros side: Industry-leading smart code analysis and refactoring engine, Deep out-of-the-box support for Spring Boot, Maven, and Gradle, Advanced database tools and built-in HTTP client, Unrivaled code navigation in large multi-module projects. On the cons side: High RAM consumption (requires 16GB+ RAM for large projects), Steep learning curve and subscription cost for Ultimate features, Slower initial indexing on large projects.
